svg.text: BASE PLATE AND FLOOR — CUT-OUTS, FIXINGS, PORTS
the 60 (Cadrane) — desk dial
DRAWING
REV
v9
SCALE
AS SHOWN
DATE
UNITS
mm
Projected from docs/v9/the60_v9/src/params.py + model.py (build123d) by hidden-line projection. No hand drafting; dimension text is written from the parameter values.
MODELLED, NOT PRINTED — no v9 part has been made. Dimensions are model values, not inspection results. Bodies tagged ENVELOPE or ASSUMED in the model are drawn as envelopes, not as the real part.
THE PLATE — HORIZONTAL SECTION AT z 2.5 scale 1 : 1
0° port slot
90° carriage
Ø124 × 5 laser-cut steel, about 385 g. Countersinks are on the underside — this view is from above.
The plate is the mass, the ground plane and the halo's bottom edge. v8's Ø123 × 3 printed plate is gone.
THE FLOOR — HORIZONTAL SECTION AT z 8.0 scale 1 : 1
motor on its carriage, 90°
speaker, cone up, on (0, -30)
driver board, 152°
Perimeter ports Ø2.0 at z 12.0 on a 15° grid: 20 of the 24 positions are drilled, 4 fall in the motor cut-out.
The speaker breathes into the cavity and out through them. Nothing fires down into the plate.
NOTES
Plate: Ø124 × 5 steel, the heaviest part of the device and its ground plane.
Its rim at r 62.0 is the bottom edge of the halo.
Two big cut-outs: the carriage stadium at 90° (Ø38.5 over r 18.9–59.8, plus a
tab slot inboard) and the port slot at 0° (32 wide, r 35 to the rim).
Fixings, all countersunk or tapped from below: 3 × M3 at 125° / 245° / 332° on
r 53 into inserts in the structure; 2 × M3 speaker cradle; 2 × M3 servo tray;
4 × M2 driver board; 2 × M2 port-face ears; 2 × M2 jack board; and one M3
ground bond beside the slot.
The port slot carries three things on two small boards: USB-C on a horizontal
board at z 2.2; the 3.5 mm jack hanging UNDER a board at z 5.0, so its body
sits at z −1 to 5, below the halo; and the light sensor on a small vertical
board looking rearward through a Ø4.80 hole in the face. One board could not
put both axes at z 2.
The speaker stands cone-UP on its rear boss at (0, -30), breathing into the
cavity and out through the perimeter ports. v8's down-firing speaker had
nowhere to fire once the plate went solid.
Pad: Ø122 at the top tapering to Ø121.4, 1.5 thick, notched at the port slot.
The carriage stands on the pad through the plate, so pad thickness is part of
the drive geometry, not just a foot.
SECTION D–D — THE BACK 1.5 : 1
port slot, r 35 to the rim
USB-C, z 2.2
3.5 mm jack, axis z 2.0
light sensor, Ø4.80 aperture
halo passes outside the slot
Section on the 0°–180° axis, right half. Nothing in the port slot reaches past r 51, and the halo sits at r 60.0–62.5, so the light band runs over the back unbroken.
The plug envelopes are ASSUMED: 12 × 6.5 × 12 for the right-angle cable outside, 10 × 6.5 × 19 for the internal straight plug.
DETAIL S — THE PORT FACE 4 : 1
Printed face 1.50 thick at r 49.5, on two M2 ears.
Face positions: USB-C -10, sensor -1, jack +9.
